text:
Chris: Morning — quick async micro-pulse. Drop 1-liners (what you did / blockers / today). I'll collect and surface asks.

Priya: Did bulk quantization experiments for the 7B suite; saw ~12% token-cost reduction. Blocked by a flaky kernel on A100 machines — test fails intermittently. Filed PR #412 and added repro steps.
```
python -m tests.quant --model gptq --seed 42 --device cuda:0
# failure reproduces ~30% of runs
```
Will pair with eng-runtime if someone has bandwidth.

Daniel: Rolled canary for runtime v2.3.1 (10% traffic) for KV-cache fix. Observability shows 3ms p50 increase but p99 stable. No obvious error bump. Will watch for 2 hours then promote.
Link: https://console.internal/observability/runs/1852 (internal)

Renee: Hosted docs update queued — private deployment networking guide needs rewritten section on peering + KMS. Blocker: waiting on security review for the KMS section. @Alex can you review the KMS snippet today?

Alex: Yup — I can review after lunch (ETA 15:30 PT). Also will take a look at PR #412 for the quant tests. :thumbsup:

Sara: Oncall update — saw a spike of 502s at 06:45 UTC tied to a broken health check on the NLB. Increased retries temporarily; cloud provider applied fix at 07:10 UTC. No customer-facing errors reported. Will follow up with incident note.

ops-bot: Alert resolved — NLB 502 spike normalized at 07:12 UTC. Incident ticket #INC-773 opened for RCA.

Priya: Quick ask — who can pair for 2pm PT on the retail-caching benchmark? Need help tuning batch sizes and validating latency SLO with prefix caching.

Daniel: I can join 2pm PT for 45m. I'll bring the canary metrics and a script to simulate request mixes.

Renee: Heads-up: customer A wants an export of token-usage per-route for the last 30 days. @Chris can you confirm the export schema so I don't have to guess?

Chris: Confirmed — route_id, model_variant, tokens_in, tokens_out, timestamp. I can sign off on the export if you post a sample.

Alex: Code-review pinged for #418 (console bugfix). Small change, but would be great to get it merged before EOD.

Chris: Summary/owners:
- Priya: investigate A100 kernel flakes with eng-runtime (owner: Priya + Daniel pairing)
- Daniel: watch canary v2.3.1, promote after 2h if stable (owner: Daniel)
- Rene(e): docs KMS review (owner: Alex to review at 15:30 PT)
- Sara: follow up on INC-773 RCA (owner: Sara)
- Renee: prepare token-export sample for Chris to sign off
- Team: pairing for retail-caching at 2pm PT (Priya + Daniel)

If anything urgent pops up ping me in DMs or tag here. Thanks :rocket:
